root_cause.description: The controlled primitive-color fixture had been scored with the Stage5B procedural-rendered learned model instead of the matching Stage5A synthetic color-prototype model.

frozen_replay.dataset: 30 frames and 76 independently labelled instances from the same sealed MCAP

offline_policy_replay.withdrawn_claim: Stage5A policy 0/0/76 is not reproducible because depth, ROI, and tracking context were not retained.

decision.reason: The measured controlled-domain raw diagnostics retain Stage5B 0/654/76 and Stage5A 33/50/43; yellow leaf piles still fail. Offline policy replay is NOT_RUN/NOT_MEASURED and the prior Stage5A policy 0/0/76 claim has been withdrawn as unsupported. Engineering recognition remains FAIL only for the actually measured raw evidence; the official >=95 percent definition/result was not measured.

limitations: Offline replay of the same frozen MCAP only; Gazebo, ROS, localization, and board were not rerun.
Highly correlated static fixture, not an independent scene population or public blind set.
Do not tune the policy threshold on this holdout; policy replay must retain depth, ROI, and tracking context before any measured claim.
Engineering recognition quality remains FAIL for measured raw evidence; the official >=95 percent result remains NOT_MEASURED.
